overall_assessment: The scholarly publication artifacts adhere to standard academic publishing requirements. The draft JOSS paper (registry/joss/paper.md) describes the statement of need, systematic search methodology, architectural design, and reproducibility framework. CITATION.cff adheres to Citation File Format 1.2.0 specifications with valid author identity, repository URLs, license identifiers, and keywords. Unit tests verify exact title and author concordance between citation files.

findings.description: The draft JOSS paper accurately bounds claims, referencing PRISMA-S as a reporting contract and describing deterministic search reproducibility without claiming autonomous screening authority.
findings.recommendation: Expand empirical benchmarking sections upon completion of prospective live evaluations in mature tracks.

findings.description: CITATION.cff metadata fields match paper.md title and repository targets with zero bibliographic drift.
findings.recommendation: Synchronize citation software version upon release tagging.

findings.description: Zenodo and OSF registration guidelines are documented with clear data integrity expectations.
findings.recommendation: Reserve immutable DOI allocation for final publication release.

calibration_notes: Scholarly publication editors confirm the academic rigor, honest claim boundaries, and citation metadata consistency.
